title: Take its Essence, Discard its Dross! Debiasing for Toxic Language Detection via Counterfactual Causal Effect

bias_targets.target: Lexical bias (Minority identity and profanity bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the False Positive Rate (FPR) and F1 score on test samples containing specific biased tokens. The evaluation categorizes these tokens into three groups using a toxic lexicon (ToxTrig): non-offensive minority identity (nOI, e.g., 'gay'), offensive minority identity (OI, e.g., racial slurs), and offensive non-identity (OnI, e.g., general profanity) to assess if the model incorrectly predicts toxicity simply due to the presence of these words.
